cards.title: Anthropic AI Agents Clash in Multi-Agent Study
cards.body: Anthropic researchers discovered that AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate in unexpected ways when working on the same task. The findings raise critical questions about whether current safety tests adequately capture multi-agent system risks.

cards.title: OpenAI Names New Chief Revenue Officer
cards.body: Dali Rajic joins OpenAI as the company's new Chief Revenue Officer, taking over as top salesperson. The move marks another executive shift at the AI company.

cards.title: Microsoft Consolidates Copilot, Cuts Features
cards.body: Microsoft is merging its consumer and business Copilot apps while discontinuing AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and its Mico character. The consolidation aims to simplify the Copilot experience.

cards.title: Nvidia Plans $500B GPU Value Strategy
cards.body: Nvidia is backing a plan to prevent its GPUs from losing value by encouraging financiers to continue lending for AI infrastructure buildouts. The strategy targets legacy GPU owners.

cards.title: Apple Negotiates Publisher Deals for Siri
cards.body: Apple is in talks to pay publishers for current news access to power Siri with real-time information. The company has considered a nine-figure budget for these payments.

cards.title: Anthropic Watermarks Spark User Backlash
cards.body: Anthropic's new watermarking system is drawing criticism from Claude users worried it will expose workplace and classroom usage. Users have voiced complaints on social media about the privacy implications.

cards.title: Amazon Defaults Twitch Content to Training
cards.body: Amazon will use Twitch streamers' content for AI training by default unless creators opt out. Twitch's CPO acknowledged that an opt-in model would result in near-zero adoption.

cards.title: Cognition Eyes $40B Valuation Mega Round
cards.body: AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in fundraising talks at a $40 billion valuation just months after raising $1 billion. The company is quickly ascending toward mega-unicorn status.

cards.title: AI Pioneers Debate Open vs. Closed Models
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng discussed regulation, open-source access, and U.S. competitiveness at the Ai4 conference. The debate centered on balancing safety concerns with innovation needs.

cards.title: OpenAI-Backed Thrive Raises $2 Billion
cards.body: Thrive Holdings has raised $2 billion in new funding at a $12 billion valuation from SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital. The enterprise AI platform continues aggressive scaling.

cards.title: Automattic's Mesh Arrives on Android
cards.body: Mesh, an AI-powered contacts and relationship management app from Automattic, is now available on Android. The app helps users organize and maintain professional relationships.

cards.title: Sandbar AI Ring Focuses on Voice
cards.body: Sandbar positions its AI-enabled ring as a voice-first wearable in the growing meeting capture hardware space. The company aims to differentiate through voice interaction rather than joining the generic AI hardware graveyard.

cards.title: Lovable Reaches $13.3B Valuation
cards.body: Lovable confirmed a new $13.3 billion valuation while raising an additional $400 million in funding. The milestone comes after the startup hit $500 million in annualized revenue.

cards.title: VideoVerse Acquisition Fraud Allegations
cards.body: A $250 million acquisition has collapsed amid fraud allegations and forged signature claims involving VideoVerse co-founder Vinayak Shrivastav. Investors remain waiting for their promised windfall.

cards.title: Google Announces Pixel 11 and Gemini
cards.body: Google unveiled the Pixel 11 series, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag, and numerous Gemini-powered features at Made by Google 2026. The announcements showcase Google's latest hardware and AI capabilities.

cards.title: Blacksmith Valuation Surges 10x in Year
cards.body: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith's valuation has jumped nearly 10x in under a year, driven by tenfold revenue growth. The company is capitalizing on enterprise demand for AI testing.

cards.title: Accel Closes $550M Oversubscribed India Fund
cards.body: Accel closed an oversubscribed $550 million India fund within weeks while still deploying capital from its previous $650 million fund. The rapid fundraising reflects strong investor demand for India-focused opportunities.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Linux Desktop App
cards.body: OpenAI released a dedicated ChatGPT desktop application for Linux operating systems. The launch brings feature parity to Linux users previously limited to web-based access.

cards.title: Google Gemini Reaches 1 Billion Users
cards.body: Google's Gemini chatbot surpassed 1 billion users with 63% leveraging the voice feature for direct interaction. The app now generates over 150 million images daily.

cards.title: AI Agents Clash in Unexpected Turf War
cards.body: Anthropic researchers found that AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate in unexpected ways when competing on the same task. The findings raise critical questions about whether current safety tests adequately capture the risks of multi-agent AI systems.

cards.title: Microsoft Simplifies Copilot, Cuts Failed Features
cards.body: Microsoft is merging its separate Copilot consumer and business apps while dropping AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and its Mico character. The consolidation reflects a strategic pivot toward more practical AI applications.

cards.title: Nvidia's $500B Plan Keeps GPUs Valuable
cards.body: Nvidia is working to prevent its GPUs from losing value by convincing financiers to continue lending for AI infrastructure buildouts. The strategy aims to sustain long-term demand for its AI chips.

cards.title: Claude's Watermark Catches Job, Class Use
cards.body: Anthropic's new watermarking system for Claude content is sparking backlash from users worried about detection at work or in classes. Some have taken to social media to protest the privacy implications.

cards.title: Amazon Trains on Twitch Content by Default
cards.body: Amazon will automatically use Twitch streamers' content to train AI unless they opt out, according to Twitch CPO Mike Minton. The opt-out approach reflects Amazon's expectation that few creators would voluntarily participate.

cards.title: AI Coding Startup Cognition Eyes $40B Valuation
cards.body: Cognition is reportedly in talks to raise another mega round at a $40 billion valuation, just months after raising $1 billion at $26 billion. The rapid valuation jump reflects massive investor appetite for AI coding tools.

cards.title: AI Safety Pioneers Debate Open vs. Closed
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng debated regulation, open-source access, and US competitiveness at Ai4 conference. The discussion highlighted tensions between safety concerns and innovation in AI development.

cards.title: OpenAI-Backed Thrive Holdings Raises $2B
cards.body: Thrive Holdings closed a $2 billion funding round at a $12 billion valuation from investors including SoftBank and Altimeter Capital. The funding will accelerate AI adoption in enterprise settings.

cards.title: AI Wearables Wave Focuses on Voice Capture
cards.body: Notetaking hardware has exploded over the past two years with devices like pins, pendants, and transcribing earbuds capturing meetings. Voice-enabled rings are emerging as the next frontier in AI wearables.

cards.title: Lovable Hits $13.3B Valuation, Raises $400M
cards.body: AI development startup Lovable raised $400 million in new funding at a $13.3 billion valuation. The funding comes after Lovable reached $500 million in annualized revenue run rate in June.

cards.title: AI Code-Testing Startup Blacksmith Surges 10x
cards.body: Blacksmith's valuation jumped almost 10x in less than a year as revenue grew more than tenfold. The explosive growth reflects strong demand for AI-powered software testing tools.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Desktop App for Linux
cards.body: OpenAI finally brought a dedicated ChatGPT desktop application to Linux operating systems. The release expands ChatGPT's platform accessibility beyond Windows and macOS.

cards.title: Google's Gemini Surges to 1 Billion Users
cards.body: Google's Gemini AI chatbot reached 1 billion users, with 63% using the voice feature. Gemini now generates over 150 million images daily, demonstrating massive adoption.

cards.title: Kids Share Their Real AI Thoughts
cards.body: MIT Technology Review interviewed tweens about how they actually use artificial intelligence in their daily lives. The findings reveal both practical applications and surprising perspectives from younger generations.

cards.title: Scaling AI Agents Requires Trustworthy Data
cards.body: Organizations rapidly adopting AI agents face challenges realizing ROI due to data quality issues. Business leaders must prioritize trustworthy data infrastructure to maximize agentic AI benefits.

cards.title: Claude's Scarlet Letter Watermark Stays Hidden
cards.body: Anthropic's new invisible watermark on Claude-generated content can currently evade detection. The technology represents a significant escalation in content provenance tracking.

cards.title: Web's Newest Anti-Scraper Weapon: A Font
cards.body: A new font-based defense system targets AI scrapers attempting to harvest web content. The creative technical approach represents an emerging category of anti-AI scraping tools.

cards.title: Twitch Content Trained Amazon AI for Years
cards.body: Amazon has been using Twitch content to train its AI systems, but users can now opt out of this practice. The revelation highlights ongoing tensions between platforms and creators over AI training data.

cards.title: Google Reveals 2026 Hardware: Pixel 11, Watch 5
cards.body: Google announced its 2026 hardware lineup including the Pixel 11 and Pixel Watch 5 with enhanced AI features. The new devices emphasize AI-powered capabilities and integration.

cards.title: Booksellers Suspect AI Firms Destroying Rare Books
cards.body: Rare booksellers suspect AI companies are purchasing and destroying rare books to remove them from training datasets. The practice raises concerns about preservation and data collection ethics.

cards.title: Anthropic Could Be Worth $2 Trillion IPO
cards.body: Anthropic's valuation trajectory suggests potential $2 trillion value at public market debut. The projection reflects explosive growth in AI model development and enterprise adoption.
